title: Winter Solstice Ceremony: Yoga Nidra & Sacred Sound
description: Dive into Winter Solstice magic with Tej Ray! Candlelit music, Yoga Nidra, breathwork sound healing for deep renewal. Join the enchantment!
long_description:
Dive into Winter Solstice magic with Tej Ray! Candlelit music, Yoga Nidra, breathwork sound healing for deep renewal. Join the enchantment!

About this Event

The Winter Solstice marks the longest night of the year—a sacred turning point where we pause, exhale, and return to the quiet center within. It is a time of stillness, dreaming, and deep restoration.
Join Tej and Ray for a candlelit journey into the heart of winter. Through original music, guided Yoga Nidra, breathwork, and immersive sound healing, you’ll be held in a space of warmth, wonder, and renewal.
The Journey Includes:
🌅 Original songs by Ray to open and close the ceremony
💫 Seasonal astrology update + guided Yoga Nidra by Tej
🎶 Live music, poetry, and moments of deep stillness
🌬 Breathwork to soothe the nervous system and settle the body
🌀 Meditation journey with kaleidoscope visuals, crystal bowls, djembe, and gong
🎼 Full sound healing immersion while resting in stillness
🌙 Closing intention ritual and shared resonance to carry forward
🧺 What to Bring:
Yoga mat + cozy layers
Blanket, bolster, pillow, or anything for deep comfort
Optional eye cover or journal
Water bottle
Pre-registration encouraged | Space is limited
